headline: Illustrative sample: one product to fix, two gaps to fill and one line to grow into
summary: This sample uses made-up brands and ASINs to show the report format. In a real run every number comes from public Amazon pages read during that run. Here, a matcha brand sells ceremonial powder in two sizes and a whisk, while its closest competitors sell sticks, latte mixes and starter kits.
top_picks: Fix the 100g tin: it costs more per gram than Leafline and Kyoto Hill with fewer ratings
Single-serve stick packs: 4 of 5 competitors sell them
Unsweetened latte mix: shoppers ask for it in reviews

catalog.notes: Sample data. A real run lists every product line found through the Store page and brand searches, and treats the list as a lower bound.

opportunities.name: 100g ceremonial matcha pouch
opportunities.what: Reprice or re-pitch the 100g pouch, which trails the same size from two competitors.
customer_signals: Good taste but pricey for the size
opportunities.differentiation: Match the value story with a clear grade and origin claim, or test a lower price.
opportunities.risks: Margin pressure if the price drops.

opportunities.name: Single-serve stick packs
opportunities.what: Launch a 30-count box of 1g ceremonial sticks for on-the-go shoppers.
evidence: 4 of 5 competitors sell a stick format
No stick listing from the seller
customer_signals: Wish this came in travel packets
opportunities.differentiation: Ceremonial grade sticks are rare; most are culinary grade.
opportunities.risks: Packaging cost per serving is higher.
opportunities.catalog_checked: Catalog rows 1 to 3; no matching format

opportunities.name: Unsweetened latte mix
opportunities.what: Add a ready latte blend with no added sugar.
evidence: Most latte mixes on page one list sugar first
customer_signals: Too sweet, I want just matcha and milk powder
opportunities.catalog_checked: Catalog rows 1 to 3; no matching format

opportunities.name: Matcha starter kit
opportunities.what: Bundle powder, bamboo whisk and bowl as one gift ready listing.
evidence: Whisk appears in bought-together on 5 of 6 top listings
opportunities.differentiation: Lead with the powder quality competitors' kits skimp on.
opportunities.catalog_checked: Catalog rows 1 to 3; whisk sold alone, no kit
